description: This file defines interfaces and implementations for managing database transactions as units of work, including specialized workflow operations, change tracking, and transaction handling with retry logic.

classes.name: unitOfWorkBackend
classes.description: Interface for backend-specific database operations related to workflows and sessions.

classes.name: unitOfWorkImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the UnitOfWork interface, managing transaction state and changes.

classes.name: workflowUnitOfWorkImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the WorkflowUnitOfWork interface, extending unitOfWorkImpl with workflow-specific methods.

methods.name: RegisterNew
methods.description: Registers a new entity to be inserted in the transaction.

methods.name: RegisterDirty
methods.description: Registers an existing entity to be updated.

methods.name: RegisterDeleted
methods.description: Registers an entity to be deleted.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Executes all registered changes as a single transaction with retry logic.

methods.name: Rollback
methods.description: Cancels all registered changes and rolls back the transaction.

methods.name: HasChanges
methods.description: Returns true if there are pending changes.

methods.name: GetChangeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of pending changes.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Returns whether the unit of work is still active.

methods.name: StoreWorkflowWithExecution
methods.description: Stores a workflow and its execution atomically.

methods.name: UpdateWorkflowStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a workflow and stores execution atomically.

methods.name: CompleteWorkflowWithResults
methods.description: Completes a workflow with results atomically.

methods.name: StoreWorkflowWithSession
methods.description: Stores a workflow and session atomically.
